Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, explicit PvP macros, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Hotfixes the default-off exact-CC NIN Auto-Seiton helper so it never ranks or dispatches into Guardian's target-side Covered status, a Paladin's Phalanx self-invulnerability, or Dark Knight Eventide's Undead Redemption. Guard/Wehr itself, the covering Paladin, and Phalanx's party mitigation remain valid. The frozen actor is rechecked before retry, optional cast cancellation, and the final native request; protection drift retires that exact epoch without a call, alternate, or replay. Seiton execute/preparation cues clear while protected, metadata drift disables the helper, and diagnostics expose the blocking status. Manual Seiton and /panicshu are unchanged; schema 31 and every existing option are preserved.
